div.div: إكَادٌ sing. of أَكَائِدٌ and تَآكِيدٌ, (K,) both of which are irreg. in relation to their sing., (TA,) signifying (i. e. the pls.) Thongs, or straps, by which the قَرَبُوس is bound to the two side-boards of a horse's saddle. (K.) [See also وِكَادٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
